name: Product truth and journey
description: Catalog-driven availability, ownership, recovery, rendering, secrets, and viewport cases.

cases.name: Four route API
cases.description: Catalog API projects all four current routes without client duplication.

cases.name: READY and coming soon
cases.description: Capability-derived availability exposes exactly one current READY route.

cases.name: COMING_SOON run blocked
cases.description: A route without required capabilities cannot create a formal Run.
cases.attack: Attempt Run creation for a coming-soon route.

cases.name: Waiting user UI
cases.description: Structured waiting state remains visible and actionable.

cases.name: Resume journey
cases.description: Structured user input resumes the existing Run.

cases.name: Snapshot refresh
cases.description: Refresh preserves exact package identities and hashes.

cases.name: Missing optional package
cases.description: Missing generated packages render truthful not-generated states.

cases.name: Cross-user snapshot request
cases.description: Another user cannot read a trip snapshot.
cases.attack: Request a Run owned by another user.

cases.name: Frontend secret scan
cases.description: Browser artifacts contain no Provider or LLM credentials.
cases.attack: Scan generated and source frontend artifacts.

cases.name: Mobile viewport
cases.description: Critical product journey remains usable at mobile width.

cases.name: All snapshot layers render
cases.description: Story, Experience, and optional Resource snapshots render from persisted data.

cases.name: Hidden sponsorship UI
cases.description: Product rendering cannot conceal sponsorship status.
cases.attack: Remove a sponsored label from rendered data.

cases.name: False READY attack
cases.description: Incomplete route capabilities cannot be presented as READY.
cases.attack: Force READY while required capabilities are missing.

cases.name: Run refresh recovery
cases.description: Refresh reconnects to the same Run without creating another one.
